en.headline: Box truck overturns on Cheung Ching Road after colliding with van
en.dek: The accident near the Shell oil depot in Tsing Yi blocked multiple lanes and caused heavy congestion on routes towards the airport on Wednesday evening.
body: A box truck overturned on Cheung Ching Road in Tsing Yi on Wednesday evening after colliding with a van, police and transport authorities said.
The incident occurred around 7 pm near the Shell oil depot at Kam Chuk Kok on the Tuen Mun-bound section. Both drivers were unhurt; the truck driver climbed out of the vehicle unaided.

Multiple lanes were blocked and intermittent closures affected Cheung Ching Tunnel and Nam Wan Tunnel towards the airport. Traffic remained heavy as of 10 pm. The Transport Department advised motorists to use alternative routes such as Tsuen Wan Road.

zh.headline: 青衣長青公路貨櫃車與客貨車相撞翻側
zh.dek: 星期三傍晚近蜆殼油庫位置發生車禍，多條行車線受阻，往機場方向交通嚴重擠塞。
body: 警方及運輸署表示，星期三傍晚約7時，一輛貨櫃車在青衣長青公路近金竹角蜆殼油庫的屯門方向路段與一輛客貨車相撞後翻側。
兩名司機均沒有受傷，貨櫃車司機自行爬出車外。多條行車線被堵塞，長青隧道及南灣隧道往機場方向亦間歇封閉。
至晚上10時交通仍然繁忙。運輸署呼籲司機改用荃灣路等替代路線。
